name: site
description: The management site of a skein (shruggr/skein#92, #125, #143): the page under /site/, served from this app's own tree (www/) by a read route whose filter `get` answers (anyone, signed or not, nothing logged). Root may add a route of its own putting it at the instance's root ({transport: "http", address: "/", prefix: true, filters: ["site.get"], root: "www"}: the default image has it).
